mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS song_id, s.score_version, s.note_count, s.default_bpm, j.bpm_unit, s.score_json FROM songs s JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, yul, octave, hanja, hangul, semitone FROM pitches ORDER BY id
